crew.overview: When Charlie Brown complains about the overwhelming materialism that he sees amongst everyone during the Christmas season, Lucy suggests that he become director of the school Christmas pageant. Charlie Brown accepts, but it is a frustrating struggle. When an attempt to restore the proper spirit with a forlorn little fir Christmas tree fails, he needs Linus' help to learn the meaning of Christmas.
crew.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas

details.biography:
Alan Louis Zaslove was an American animator, producer and director of animated series. He started in 1943 as an "office boy" for Leon Schlesinger Productions and went on to work for United Productions of America. He did animation for Gerald McBoing-Boing and Mr. Magoo. Zaslove has also worked on several other cartoons in film and TV such, later he did work for Hanna-Barbera and Disney.

During his time at Disney he shared Daytime Emmy Award nominations for that and work on Darkwing Duck.

When not working at Disney Zaslove worked as a supervising producer and director on The New Woody Woodpecker Show.
details.name: Alan Zaslove
